buffered_iter_lines_after_breach.cause: The already-started line iterator suspends inside yield from lines. Another reader crosses the shared byte limit, storing ResponseTooLarge, but resuming that iterator yields its next buffered line without calling _check_response_size. It performs no further raw read; the contract also requires later reads to raise.

The test concerns binding before subsequent hook consumption, not retroactively stopping the earlier unlimited transport.
